_doc: Starting gesture table for the 22 Hebrew letters + the /a/ vowel, MOUTH v2 adult tract (eran2:~/mouth-v2/mouth2.py, AGE_MONTHS 300, 17.60 cm, 23 sections). Written by claude-cli-PEH 2026-09-02 from measured probes (eran2:~/throat-one-sample/out/manual-probes/). Broken Windows: every range here is a MEASURED starting point, not a verified syllable -- signature_ok is false for all rows until a render is checked against its signature.

VOWEL_KF.note: mouth2.keyframe(AH) default. Measured in gesture space: F1 580 F2 1226 F3 2550, HNR 9.0 dB (NOT the 729/1276 of the say() fit -- the PCHIP-log spline + the 0.65/2.0 dilation make a different tube).

conventions.c_pos: 0 = glottis, 1 = lips, on the 16.77 cm ladder (cm from lips = (1-c_pos)*16.77). Clipped [0.30, 1.00]. Nasal junction at 0.41; constrictions at 0.30-0.45 sit on or behind it.
conventions.c_area: cm2 at the constriction centre (Gaussian sigma 0.75 cm). 0.0 = seal (pressure builds if voicing > 0 and velum < 0.05). 0.01-0.09 = DEAD ZONE (no seal, no noise). 0.10-0.25 = fricative channel (noise on, full). >= 0.49 = no noise. Clipped [0, 2].
conventions.velum: nasal port cm2, clipped [0, 0.8]; a switch above 0.05.
conventions.voicing: 0..1, scales BOTH the pulse and the glottal aspiration; 10 ms one-pole. voicing 0 is not silence (turbulence is independent of it).
conventions.tenseness: effective = utterance contour x keyframe/0.6, clipped [0.25, 0.95]. 0.25 breathy (H1-H2 +13 dB, centroid 270), 0.95 pressed (H1-H2 -3 dB, centroid 633, +5 dB louder).

rows.name: alef
rows.place: glottal (voicing onset; the tract has no glottal seal, c_pos floor is 0.30)

signature.pre: silence <= -20 dB re vowel for >= 50 ms (measured -22.6)
signature.onset: voicing rises 10-90% in <= 70 ms (measured 70 ms with glide 0.02; 140 with 0.35)

rows.recipe: keyframes [keyframe(AH, c_pos=0.97, c_area=0.0, voicing=0.0), keyframe(AH, voicing=0.0), VOWEL_KF], durations [0.05, 0.05, 0.35], glide 0.02. The lip seal in the first keyframe kills the AH tube's own -16 dB hiss; voicing=0 alone is NOT silence.
rows.note: Israeli Hebrew: alef and ayin are the same onset. Alt for a Mizrahi ayin: c_pos 0.30-0.35 c_area 0.3-0.5 voiced 40 ms -- NOT probed (UNKNOWN).

rows.name: bet

signature.closure: <= -25 dB re vowel for 40-100 ms (measured -30.9 at 0.97)
signature.burst: within 10 ms of release, +3 dB re vowel at gain 2.2 / +8 at gain 6; burst centroid 500-600 Hz (lowest of the places)
signature.voicing: continuous through closure (voice bar at -31 dB)

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_c, kf_c, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.10, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_c = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0, voicing=1.0). Voicing MUST stay >0 during the closure (pressure builds from |source|; a voicing-0 closure makes NO burst -- measured). Release = the 35% glide of the vowel segment.
rows.note: Only the lips seal properly in this ladder (0.96-0.99: -26 to -33 dB). 1.00 is worse (-25). c_area 0.005 is NOT a seal for sound (+3 dB leak mid-tract, -18 at lips) -- use exactly 0.0.

rows.name: vet

signature.noise: >2 kHz fraction >= 0.10 (measured 0.195 at voicing 0.3 ten 0.25; 0.01 at voicing 1.0 = invisible)
signature.level: -10 to -25 dB re vowel (weak, flat: centroid ~2.2 kHz at 0.98 voiceless)

rows.recipe: as the voiceless fricative but voicing 0.3-0.5 and tenseness 0.25-0.40 (at voicing 1.0 the noise is invisible: >2 kHz fraction 0.01 = the vowel's own; at voicing 0.3/ten 0.25 it is 0.195 with f0 still measurable).
rows.note: Same sound as vav in Israeli Hebrew.

rows.name: gimel
rows.place: back of tongue -- the ONLY mid-tract seal that holds is 0.48-0.51

signature.closure: <= -20 dB re vowel (measured -24.7 at 0.50; 0.56-0.65 does NOT close: -1.6 to -4.4 dB)
signature.burst: burst centroid 900-980 Hz (highest of the places)
signature.transition: F2 onset RAISED ~1515 falling to 1219 (velar pinch), F1 522 -> 582

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_c, kf_c, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.10, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_c = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0, voicing=1.0). Voicing MUST stay >0 during the closure (pressure builds from |source|; a voicing-0 closure makes NO burst -- measured). Release = the 35% glide of the vowel segment.
rows.note: The 'velar' place 0.56-0.65 leaks through the Gaussian taper in this ladder; 0.50 is where the seal holds (three sections < 0.013 cm2). Treat 0.48-0.51 as k/g place.

rows.name: dalet
rows.place: tongue tip -- use 0.94-0.95 (the ridge 0.86-0.92 leaks -8 to -12 dB)

signature.transition: F3 onset HIGH 2855-2890 falling to 2705; F1 502 -> 582; F2 ~flat 1248 -> 1219

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_c, kf_c, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.10, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_c = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0, voicing=1.0). Voicing MUST stay >0 during the closure (pressure builds from |source|; a voicing-0 closure makes NO burst -- measured). Release = the 35% glide of the vowel segment.
rows.note: d vs b: F3 onset (2855 vs 2777) and burst centroid (740 vs 590 at gain 6). Weak cues -- expect ERAN to confuse d/b at first.

rows.name: he
rows.place: pharynx / glottis (noise from c_pos 0.32-0.40; no closure)

signature.noise: 50-90 ms, HNR < 0 dB (measured -8.7 at voicing 0, -3.7 at voicing 0.2 ten 0.25), centroid 3.7-5.1 kHz
signature.no: no closure, no burst, no low-frequency murmur

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_h, kf_h, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.08, 0.02-0.03, 0.30-0.40]; kf_h = keyframe(AH, c_pos=0.35, c_area=0.15, tenseness=0.25, voicing=0.2).
rows.note: Physically a [h] carries the following vowel's formants; this recipe's noise is pharyngeal-coloured (F 1106/1634). ALT 'breathy onset': VOWEL_KF with voicing 0.3 tenseness 0.25 for 70 ms -> HNR 2.4, centroid 1082, formants 565/1317/2543 = vowel colour, level -10.9 dB. Try both on Iddo's ear.

rows.name: vav

signature.same_as: vet: f0 present + >2 kHz fraction >= 0.10, level -10 to -25 dB, no closure

rows.recipe: as the voiceless fricative but voicing 0.3-0.5 and tenseness 0.25-0.40 (at voicing 1.0 the noise is invisible: >2 kHz fraction 0.01 = the vowel's own; at voicing 0.3/ten 0.25 it is 0.195 with f0 still measurable).
rows.note: Identical to vet in Israeli Hebrew.

rows.name: zayin

signature.noise: >2 kHz fraction >= 0.15, centroid ~3 kHz (measured 0.195 / 3069 Hz at 0.92/0.12/voicing 0.3/ten 0.25)

rows.recipe: as the voiceless fricative but voicing 0.3-0.5 and tenseness 0.25-0.40 (at voicing 1.0 the noise is invisible: >2 kHz fraction 0.01 = the vowel's own; at voicing 0.3/ten 0.25 it is 0.195 with f0 still measurable).
rows.note: The s/z pair: z = s + partial voicing. At voicing 1.0 it is just the vowel (HNR 8.4, >2k 0.01).

rows.name: chet

signature.noise: >= 80 ms, centroid 1.9-2.5 kHz, 1-3 kHz fraction >= 0.85 (measured 0.91-0.94 at 0.50-0.52), HNR <= 1 dB
signature.no: no closure, no burst, no voicing

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_f, kf_f, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.08-0.12, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_f = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area, velum=0, voicing=0.0). c_area must be 0.10-0.25 (below 0.09 there is NO noise at all -- measured dead zone).
rows.note: Same as khaf. The noise place map: 0.50-0.52 -> 2.0 kHz; 0.55 -> 2.5 kHz; 0.60-0.65 -> 4.4-5.0 kHz (loudest place, but too bright for chet).

rows.name: tet
rows.voicing: 1.0 in closure, 0.0 in the 30-50 ms gap

signature.burst: +5 dB re vowel at gain 2.2, +14 at gain 6, within 5 ms; centroid 850-950 Hz
signature.gap: 30-50 ms VOT at -3 to -6 dB re vowel (noise + ring, not silence)

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_c, kf_c, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.10, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_c = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0, voicing=1.0). Voicing MUST stay >0 during the closure (pressure builds from |source|; a voicing-0 closure makes NO burst -- measured). Release = the 35% glide of the vowel segment. For the voiceless letter insert keyframe(AH, voicing=0.0) for 0.03-0.05 s between kf_c and VOWEL_KF (the VOT gap); backend='c' with g['burst']={'gain':6.0,'tau_s':0.003} for a real explosion (+14 to +18 dB re vowel measured; the default 2.2 gives only +3 to +8).
rows.note: Same sound as tav.

rows.name: yod
rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_y, kf_y, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06, 0.02, 0.32], glide 0.5-0.6; kf_y = keyframe(mouth2.vowel_knots('i'), c_pos=0.75, c_area=0.5, voicing=1.0). The knots CHANGE here (i-tube, not AH).
rows.note: vowel_knots('i') alone measures 299/1930/2692 -- the constriction is optional; 0.3 gives F1 245.

rows.name: kaf
rows.voicing: 1.0 in closure, 0.0 in the 30-50 ms gap

signature.burst: +6.6 dB at gain 2.2, +14.3 at gain 6; centroid 800-900 Hz

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_c, kf_c, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.10, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_c = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0, voicing=1.0). Voicing MUST stay >0 during the closure (pressure builds from |source|; a voicing-0 closure makes NO burst -- measured). Release = the 35% glide of the vowel segment. For the voiceless letter insert keyframe(AH, voicing=0.0) for 0.03-0.05 s between kf_c and VOWEL_KF (the VOT gap); backend='c' with g['burst']={'gain':6.0,'tau_s':0.003} for a real explosion (+14 to +18 dB re vowel measured; the default 2.2 gives only +3 to +8).
rows.note: Same as qof. khaf (the fricative) = chet row.

rows.name: khaf

signature.same_as: chet: centroid ~2 kHz, 1-3 kHz fraction >= 0.85, level -4 to -8 dB

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_f, kf_f, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.08-0.12, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_f = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area, velum=0, voicing=0.0). c_area must be 0.10-0.25 (below 0.09 there is NO noise at all -- measured dead zone).
rows.note: Identical to chet.

rows.name: lamed
rows.manner: narrow-wide (voiced approximant; no lateral channel exists in a single tube)

signature.voicing: continuous, level within +-2 dB of the vowel (measured -0.1 to +0.2)
signature.F1: <= 470 during the consonant (measured 417 at 0.30, 466 at 0.50) vs ~580 in the vowel
signature.no: no burst (release peak +2 dB = vowel onset), no closure below -6 dB
signature.noise: HNR ~5 (the channel sits in the turbulence window; a real l has none)

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_l, kf_l, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.07-0.10, 0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_l = keyframe(AH, c_pos=0.88, c_area=0.4, velum=0.0, voicing=1.0). Velum MUST be 0 (Iddo heard 'mwah' when la shared ma's nasal template).
rows.note: Weak contrast with the vowel; the F1 dip is the only cue. c_area >= 0.5 keeps it out of the turbulence window (thin -> 0 at 0.49) at the cost of F1 (466).

rows.name: mem

signature.murmur: 80-200 ms, >= 95% of power below 500 Hz (measured 99.3%), nose/lip >= +30 dB (measured +35.9), level -2 dB re vowel (loud)
signature.release: NO burst (velum open = no pressure), F1 onset ~510 -> 580

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_n, kf_n, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.08-0.15, 0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_n = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0.75, voicing=1.0). Velum is a switch: anything above 0.05 is fully nasal (+33.8 dB at 0.05, +35.9 at 0.75 measured); with the velum open no pressure builds, so there is no burst -- that is the m/b difference.
rows.note: The m/n cue is the antiformant (1.66 kHz vs 2.0-2.5) and the F3 onset. train_syl2 found c_pos 0.90 velum 0.72-0.98 on IDDO-ma.wav.

rows.name: nun

signature.antiformant: 2.0-2.5 kHz (measured 2000 at 0.93, 2523 at 0.90) -- higher than m

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_n, kf_n, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.08-0.15, 0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_n = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0.75, voicing=1.0). Velum is a switch: anything above 0.05 is fully nasal (+33.8 dB at 0.05, +35.9 at 0.75 measured); with the velum open no pressure builds, so there is no burst -- that is the m/b difference.
rows.note: For nun the seal need not be tight (the nose carries the sound), so 0.90 is fine here even though it leaks for d. A back nasal at 0.50 gives nose/lip +51 dB, antiformant 2945, F2 onset 1549 -- that is [ng], not nun.

rows.name: samekh

signature.no: no voicing, no closure, no burst

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_f, kf_f, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.08-0.12, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_f = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area, velum=0, voicing=0.0). c_area must be 0.10-0.25 (below 0.09 there is NO noise at all -- measured dead zone).
rows.note: Same as sin. s vs sh: >4 kHz fraction 0.56 vs 0.23; centroid 4.5 vs 3.7 kHz. Nyquist is 8 kHz, so a real /s/ peak (5-8 kHz) is only half visible.

rows.name: ayin

signature.same_as: alef: >= 50 ms at <= -20 dB then a <= 70 ms rise into the vowel; no burst, no noise

rows.recipe: as alef.
rows.note: Pharyngeal ayin (Mizrahi) = c_pos 0.30-0.35 c_area 0.3-0.5 voiced 40 ms: NOT probed.

rows.name: pe
rows.voicing: 1.0 in closure, 0.0 in the 30-50 ms gap

signature.burst: +8 dB at gain 2.2, +17.9 at gain 6, within 5 ms; centroid 700-900 Hz

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_c, kf_c, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06-0.10, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_c = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area=0.0, velum=0, voicing=1.0). Voicing MUST stay >0 during the closure (pressure builds from |source|; a voicing-0 closure makes NO burst -- measured). Release = the 35% glide of the vowel segment. For the voiceless letter insert keyframe(AH, voicing=0.0) for 0.03-0.05 s between kf_c and VOWEL_KF (the VOT gap); backend='c' with g['burst']={'gain':6.0,'tau_s':0.003} for a real explosion (+14 to +18 dB re vowel measured; the default 2.2 gives only +3 to +8).
rows.note: b vs p = the gap (VOT) and the burst size; the closure is identical.

rows.name: fe

signature.noise: weak, flat: level -25 dB re vowel (measured -25.7), centroid ~2.2 kHz, HNR < 0
signature.no: no voicing, no closure, no burst

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_f, kf_f, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.08-0.12, 0.01-0.02, 0.30-0.40]; kf_f = keyframe(AH, c_pos, c_area, velum=0, voicing=0.0). c_area must be 0.10-0.25 (below 0.09 there is NO noise at all -- measured dead zone).
rows.note: The weakest sound the mouth makes (rms 0.017 at 1.00 vs 0.059 at 0.90). May need more noise than the model has.

rows.name: tsadi

signature.fricative: 60-80 ms at -5 to -9 dB, centroid >= 3.5 kHz (3733), >4 kHz fraction >= 0.4

rows.recipe: keyframes [kf_t, kf_t, kf_s, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.06, 0.01, 0.08, 0.30]; kf_t = keyframe(AH, 0.95, 0.0, voicing=1.0); kf_s = keyframe(AH, 0.90, 0.12, voicing=0.0).

signature.same_as: kaf: closure <= -20 dB, burst +6.6/+14.3, gap 30-50 ms, F2 onset raised

rows.note: Identical to kaf in Israeli Hebrew.

rows.name: resh

signature.primary: 50-80 ms continuous voicing, HNR ~6, F2 raised ~1470 falling to 1220, F1 ~420, centroid ~600 (measured 0.50/0.20)
signature.alt_tap: 25-35 ms seal at 0.93-0.95: dip >= 10 dB for ~10 ms (measured -12 dB at 0.93/30 ms), no burst gap, voicing continuous
signature.no: no noise band above 2 kHz, no nasal

rows.recipe: primary: keyframes [kf_r, kf_r, VOWEL_KF], durations [0.05-0.08, 0.02, 0.30]; kf_r = keyframe(AH, 0.50, 0.20, voicing=1.0). tap: [VOWEL_KF?, keyframe(AH, 0.94, 0.0, voicing=1.0), VOWEL_KF] durations [.., 0.03, 0.35] glide 0.5.
rows.note: Iddo's resh is uvular, so IDDO-ra.wav will be the primary. The tap is what the brief asked to verify; 20 ms is too short (-5 dB only).

rows.name: shin

signature.noise: >= 80 ms, centroid 3.3-3.8 kHz (measured 3729 at 0.80/0.18), 2-4 kHz fraction >= 0.65 (0.73), >4 kHz fraction <= 0.3, HNR < 0
signature.level: -6 to -10 dB re vowel (measured -8.7; louder than s)

rows.note: 0.75-0.80 is the sh band in the place map (2-4 kHz fraction 0.68-0.76).

rows.name: vowel

signature.formants: F1 ~580 F2 ~1225 F3 ~2550 in gesture space (measured 580/1226/2550; say() path gives 742/1288/2559 = the fit's own 729/1276/2571)
signature.no: no transitions, no noise band, no nasal (nose -198 dB)

rows.recipe: keyframes [VOWEL_KF], durations [0.30-0.60], f0_knots [105,105,98], tenseness_knots [0.6,0.6,0.55].
rows.note: The AH tube has two natural narrowings inside the turbulence window (0.384 cm2 at 0.41, 0.277 at 0.717). The default keyframe dilates the second; the first hisses at -16.5 dB whenever voicing is 0. AH4 (knot 4 -> -0.9) is digitally silent at voicing 0 and measures 614/1303/2673.
